scenes.text: The ocean's scariest hunter was once as long as your arm.
Then the ocean grew armour, then jaws, then teeth the size of your hand.

setting.look: macro: plate at 1.35x behind the head shield
code: Ocean dusk key, warm surface glow at the top, jaws from below
code: museum board, tooth beside a hand

scenes.text: Drop into each ocean. No boat, just you, treading water. How long until something eats you?

setting.look: wide: camera pulled back to 1.0 inside the overscan

scenes.text: Half a billion years ago? Nothing can. It probably couldn't even crack a shell. You last until your arms give out.

setting.look: dive: 0.35 s tilt down inside the split plate, then a bubble-curtain wipe
rise: bubble wipe upward, back to the surface

scenes.text: Armour. Dunkleosteus, a fish as long as a car, with bone blades instead of teeth, built to crack other armoured fish. You're not armoured. Minutes.

setting.place: Late Devonian sea, 360 million years ago
